fields.title: Damage tolerance
fields.finding: 045 reports cascading member loss and running tears in predecessor configurations. No damage-tolerance repair is qualified or silently assigned zero cost here.
fields.proposed_fix: Demonstrate residual strength, tear arrest, impact resistance and realistic protection/inspection; carry all added mass.

claim: 045 reports cascading member loss and running tears in predecessor configurations. No damage-tolerance repair is qualified or silently assigned zero cost here. | Damage tolerance
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
